title: Crystal structure setup
action: Generate the input file for a LaCoO3 supercell (2 formula units, 4 Co atoms) in the rhombohedral R3c space group with lattice parameters a=b=c=5.3778 Å, α=β=γ=60.798°. Use a 2×1×1 supercell to accommodate different spin configurations.
description: Prepare the geometric structure for all subsequent DFT runs.

title: PBE+U low-spin band gaps
action: Run PBE+U (Dudarev scheme) self-consistent field calculations for the low-spin (S=0) state at Ueff=3.0, 5.0, and 7.0 eV. For each converged calculation, extract the band gap (difference between valence band maximum and conduction band minimum). Save the three band gaps in a JSON file 'pbeu_ls_bandgaps.json' with structure [{"U": <value>, "band_gap_eV": <value>}].
description: Compute band gaps for the low-spin state under PBE+U.

title: HSE low-spin band gaps
action: Run HSE06 hybrid functional calculations for the low-spin state at mixing factors α=0.05, 0.15, and 0.25. Extract the band gap for each. Save in 'hse_ls_bandgaps.json' with structure [{"alpha": <value>, "band_gap_eV": <value>}].
description: Compute band gaps for the low-spin state under HSE.

title: Spin-state energies at U=3.0 eV
action: Run PBE+U (U=3.0 eV) spin-polarized calculations for the low-spin (LS, S=0), intermediate-spin (IS, ferromagnetic, S=1), and LS-HS 1:1 mixing (ferromagnetic) configurations. For each converged state, extract the total electronic energy (eV). Save in 'spin_energies_u3.json' with structure [{"spin_state": "LS"/"IS_FM"/"LS-HS_1:1_FM", "total_energy_eV": <value>}].
description: Compute total energies of different spin states to verify near-degeneracy.

title: Aggregate results into scored artifact
action: Collect the results from steps s02, s03, s04. For each entry create an object with fields: method (string, “PBE+U” or “HSE”), parameter (float, U or α), spin_state (string, e.g. “LS”, “IS_FM”, “LS-HS_1:1_FM”), band_gap_eV (float, or null if not applicable), total_energy_eV (float, or null if not applicable). Write all objects into a single JSON list file “dft_results.json” under /app/outputs.
description: Compile the computed band gaps and spin-state energies into the required scored artifact.
output_schema: Array of objects, each containing: method (string, e.g. 'PBE+U' or 'HSE'), parameter (float, U or α), spin_state (string, e.g. 'LS'/'IS_FM'/'LS-HS_1:1_FM'), band_gap_eV (float|null), total_energy_eV (float|null).
